AC fans, let's talk... This is my opinion but I feel that others may feel this way as well. Note: I posted this on reddit but felt I should bring this here to v/gaming as well on Voat.

So quick backstory, I've been a fan of the series since the first title, and loved it a whole lot more after AC II and AC:B. I somewhat enjoyed playing AC III, even with it's bugs, but at this point I was starting to feel the fatigue. And after that ending I just had had enough. Why did I scale all the buildings, work on the subject 16 puzzles and get so hyped for Desmond's storyline, and then was given such a lackluster of an ending in AC III? As a fan of the series I felt kind of let down. You know after playing through all the glitches and putting up with the problems of AC III, I decided not to purchase any more AC titles. This isn't to boycott the franchise or anything, but I just did not want to spend more of my own money on a video game series that was just not fun to me anymore. And it got to that point where there was a new Assassin's Creed title every year. It's starting to become the new Call of Duty.

So anyways, after AC III I put the series to the side and just watched videos on youtube to keep up with what's been happening (why not right? I've already invested so much into this series). My friend gave me his Wii U version of AC IV late last year, and although I didn't have high hopes for it, it was actually quite refreshing. Gameplay felt right and more polished than AC III, and I actually felt like an assassin again, like Ezio or Altair, albeit the pirate bit. I enjoyed it! But I still wasn't sold. Because next up was AC Unity. While I was considering purchasing the game, I saw all the problems it had as well, and again a really mediocre plot. I've played it but haven't purchased it. It's just not worth it.

So here we are now. AC Syndicate is just around the corner and again I don't really care for it or the story. I don't have that special feeling I got when I was playing AC II and AC:B anymore. It feels like after Patrice left his baby behind, it just did not grow enough to be all that it could be. And it just seems like I've been given too much of Assassin's Creed over the past 5 years that I'm exhausted of the franchise and it's recent mediocre games.

So what do you all think of the current state of the AC franchise? Is anyone else getting a little fatigued?

TL;DR : I complain about the franchise getting mediocre and it's getting exhausting with all these new AC games every year. AC II and AC:B were better story wise than the past 4 games. Is it because Patrice Desilet left his baby while AC: B was being developed? Is Ubisoft just milking the franchise?
They're pumping them out waaaay too fast. They need to take some time and polish each one.
What they need to do is innovate, like they did with black flag in terms of privateering.
This would have been an amazing series if they put one out ever 2.5-3 years. We'd just now be getting a third or fourth and they'd be awesome.

I felt like the world got smaller with each game somehow. The buildings were't as tall, you couldn't see as far, it just felt more compartmentalized in general. I was never that much of a fan, I enjoyed the first games in the series but I didn't play religiously. About 3 months before releasing I was duped into pre-ordering AC III from GameStop - the deal was alright, but the checkout-girl behind the counter was fine. And like most everybody else I couldn't even finish the damn thing, it was buggy and bad. Ever since then I've been cautious about Assassin's Creed. To my surprise the game I enjoy the most is Black Flag! Sure, it's somewhat simple, but I like it more than the others, I've yet to try Rogue but I hear it's somewhat the same. I did try Unity because it came with my Xbox One but the 5-6 hours I played it were so bug-riddled I doubt I'll ever try it again, which is sad because mechanically it seemed like the superior game. And now they have this Syndicate thing and I'm not even interested. Why not Feudal Japan or something, Ubisoft? At this point I don't know what's up with the series, I just know I'd prefer something awesome as opposed to something mediocre.
Agreed. Syndicate seems to be another rehash of Unity and I'm just not excited for it.

I will have to agree with you. I was a huge fan of the series from the first game, and have just finished playing through in order to revelations (just wrapped that one up this morning). I rather enjoyed black flag, tho... I do not believe it should have been in the same series. Highly fun, but not an AC game. I never got around to playing unity, my passion for the series started waning after I first completed Revelations and all the reviews for Unity destroyed my desire to have anything to do with that iteration.

All in all, as much fun as I have had following Desmond, it is time to let the series end IMO. My favourite series in all other media (cowboy bepop for anime, Firefly for series) rank quite highly in my mind because they had a clear ending. Let a series end when it is time, and it will be a far stronger fan favourite because of it.

They are milking it BIG time. Gameplay wise, the two first Assassins Creed games were the best. They actually focused on stealth and sneaking around enermies, the climping system were a bit slower but WAY better because of realism. The way you had to climb left or right, jump or not, it was really something good.

Then they made the more action based AC games, witch really sucks. Assassins Creed wasnt meant to be played by charging in and just fucking wrecking all shit that moves. The new "stealth" sucks (im talking AC3/4), hiding and running around bushes all day isnt really stelth to me. The new games really killed the franchise for me. Getting all casual and shit**.

Ubisoft just milking the franchise

Yes, absolutely. The time-span between each title gets constantly shorter, hell there are more AC games being made than Call of Duties.. That alone is enough for people to get tired, limited innovation-possibilities as well as low risk-taking is doing the other part.

The new titles can still be good of-course, but the novelty is simply gone.

I think they should do 2 more games and call it, then wait a while and do a new story line.

The last game should be set in present with Desmond brought back from the dead since it's what we all have been waiting on. I didn't care much for the ending of AC3

I agree. My first game in the series was AC2 and it was really a phenomenal game. Then I played Brotherhood, which was iterative but improved on AC2 in a lot of ways; I think I actually like it better. I never played Revelations but read some disappointing reviews of it, that may have been the beginning of the downfall. AC3 was a total disappointment.

I don't think Ubisoft will ever be able to bring the franchise back to the quality level of the Ezio games. The release cycles are too short and they painted themselves into a corner narratively. None of the new games interest me very much. I did play Rogue and while the gameplay was acceptable, the story was short and uninteresting. It just didn't have much soul.
